title: 第二十一章 罕见第二十二章 奇葩
content_zh:
很快，缉捕七道湾大当家的一队人马从城门口飞掠而出。
这队人马一出，整个执徐城虚晃了一下，如幻影般波动着淡化，偌大个城池突然就凭空消失在了虚空中。
外面赶往城门口的人陆续止步，纷纷傻眼，城没了，天地空旷，唯有远山和空荡荡四野，若不是看到还有其他人也是朝这来的，还以为自己走错了方向。
许多人不知道是怎么回事，也有人知道只有一种情况会出现这种状况，那就是执徐城关闭城门彻底封了城。
这是很罕见的事，许多人从未见过，大多人只是听说。
城头上的守卫看外界光景没有变化，依然如故……
客居厢房，貌似淡定的巴应山再次来访，见了祁月如一开口就是低声急催，“快走，你不能再留了，快点离开这。”
祁月如也从他反应上看出了不对，肯定是要问一下的，“怎么了？”
不问还好，一问，巴应山就忍不住火冒三丈，咬牙切齿道：“信了你的鬼话去抓那两个地头蛇，此事已令巡狱使起了疑心，巡狱使已接管大牢，正亲自参与审讯。”
祁月如难以置信道：“抓这么两个人能惊动巡狱使？这可是你的地盘，你到底是怎么搞的，这也能搞砸？”
“谁能想到，兰巧颜那娘们居然也插了一脚……”巴应山当即把事发的大概情况讲了下。
祁月如听后很是无语，没想到竟能出这样的意外，居然会让兰巧颜误以为是冲她去的，这到哪说理去？
若说兰巧颜是为了救未来女婿，别说巴应山，连她也不信兰巧颜能看上这种蝼蚁，将心比心，她也是女人。
如此说来，这还真只是一场误会。
现在也顾不上了是不是误会，事已至此，杜火官亲自介入了，虽然巴应山说线索已经掐断了，可她也不敢再逗留了，真要向准了那两个地头蛇深挖，一些事情是很容易做联想的。
当即遵了巴应山的意，迅速收拾东西准备走人。
之前她还磨着这边想把儿子和弟弟的遗体带出去安葬，然这边有规矩，死在这里的流放者，一律在此尘归尘、土归土，但凡事都有例外，可她现在已经顾不上了这个，生怕晚了想跑都跑不掉。
一起走不方便，巴应山出了厢房先走一步，然才出门没几步，便骤然停步，仰头看向上方虚空，变了脸色。
屋内向外张望的祁月如见他还没走，停在那迟迟没反应，当即走了出去，打量了一下四周，刚要开口询问，巴应山已经先开口了，“你暂时怕是走不了了。”
祁月如有些紧张道：“什么意思？”

话刚落，给她答案的便来了，巴城主的那个心腹手下匆匆来到，对巴城主低声禀报道：“城主，巡狱使下令封城了，通往城外的所有通道全部切断了！”
巴应山面色凝重的嗯了声，让其先退下后，回头看了眼脸色难看的祁月如，轻轻给了句，“这回你满意了？”
明显在嘲讽她之前的不听劝，非要搞事。
此时巴应山也不好多说什么发泄，示意了她回屋里安心等着，便快步离开了。
content_en:
Soon, a team of people arresting the master of Qidaowan flew out from the city gate.
As soon as this team of troops came out, the entire Zhixu City swayed, fluctuating and fading like a phantom, and the huge city suddenly disappeared into the void.
People outside rushing to the city gate stopped one after another, and they were dumbfounded. The city was gone, the sky and the earth were empty, and there were only distant mountains and empty fields. If they hadn't seen other people coming here, they would have thought that they were going in the wrong direction.
Many people don't know what's going on, and some people know that this situation can only occur in one situation, and that is to close the city gates and completely seal the city.
This is a rare thing, many people have never seen it, and most people have only heard about it.
The guards on the top of the city saw that the outside scene had not changed, it remained the same...
In the guest room, Ba Yingshan, who seemed calm, came to visit again. When he saw Qi Yueru, he whispered urgently, "Let's go, you can't stay any longer. Get out of here quickly."
Qi Yueru also saw something was wrong from his reaction and must have asked, "What's wrong?"
It's okay not to ask, but when asked, Bayingshan couldn't help but get angry, gritted his teeth and said: "I believed your lies and went to catch those two local snakes. This matter has made the prison inspector suspicious. The prison inspector has taken over the prison and is personally participating in the interrogation."
Qi Yueru said in disbelief: "How can arresting these two people alert the prison patrol? This is your territory. How did you do it? Can you mess this up?"
"Who would have thought that that girl Lan Qiaoyan actually had a hand in it..." Bayingshan immediately told the general story of what happened.
Qi Yueru was speechless after hearing this. She didn't expect that such an accident would happen and that Lan Qiaoyan would mistakenly think that he was going after her. How could this be justified?
If Lan Qiaoyan was trying to save her future son-in-law, let alone Bayingshan, even she didn't believe that Lan Qiaoyan could fall in love with such an ant. She was also a woman.
In this case, this is really just a misunderstanding.
Now she couldn't care less about whether it was a misunderstanding or not. Du Huoguan personally intervened in the matter now. Although Ba Yingshan said that the clues had been cut off, she did not dare to stay any longer. If she really wanted to dig deeper into the two local snakes, it was easy to make associations with some things.
He immediately obeyed Bayingshan's wishes and quickly packed up his things to leave.
Before, she was still trying to take the bodies of her son and brother out for burial, but there are rules here. The exiles who died here will return to dust and earth, but there are exceptions to everything. But now she can't care about this, for fear that it will be too late and she won't be able to escape even if she wants to.
It was inconvenient to walk together, so Bayingshan took a step out of the wing first. Then, after a few steps out, he suddenly stopped, looked up into the void above, and his expression changed.
Qi Yueru, who was looking out of the room, saw that he hadn't left yet and stopped there without responding. He immediately walked out and looked around. When he was about to ask, Bayingshan had already spoken first, "I'm afraid you won't be able to leave for the time being."
Qi Yueru said nervously: "What do you mean?"
As soon as she finished speaking, the person who gave her the answer came. City Lord Ba's confidant hurriedly arrived and reported to City Lord Ba in a low voice: "City Lord, the prison patrol has ordered the city to be closed, and all passages leading outside the city have been cut off!"
Bayingshan nodded solemnly and asked him to step aside. He looked back at Qi Yueru, who had an ugly face, and said softly, "Are you satisfied this time?"
Obviously he was mocking her for not listening to advice and insisting on causing trouble.
At this time, Bayingshan didn't have much to say to vent, so he signaled her to go back to the house and wait peacefully, and left quickly.
